hypotheses.alternative: Layout-diverse SFT has a larger varied-minus-canonical effect than canonical-only SFT.
hypotheses.null: Layout-diverse and canonical-only SFT have the same presentation effect.

name: v3b-development-recovery
pivot_criteria: Otherwise retire V3B as a main path while retaining its evidence and continue the adaptive-context program.
primary_estimand: Mean across training seeds of the treatment-minus-control difference in each arm's varied-minus-canonical exact-match rate.
promotion_criteria: Both seed effects are positive; their mean is at least 0.05; canonical loss is no worse than -0.02; and treatment failures increase by no more than 0.01.
question: Does layout-diverse SFT improve exact-match robustness to varied input layouts without reducing canonical-layout behavior?
split_policy: Use development tasks only. Never open V3B sealed-test task or reference bytes.
statistical_unit: training seed; latent tasks are paired and nested within each seed
stopping_rule: Run every admitted episode unless integrity or provider failure interrupts.
validity_threats: The evaluation uses development tasks rather than pristine held-out tasks.
